verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a machine-readable OpenAPI spec at /openapi.json, docs that name concrete endpoints such as `POST /ach_transfers`, and a Sandbox where every API feature is available. A user could load the spec into an external tool and run calls against Sandbox, but nothing shows Increase ships its own interactive, runnable API reference. Missing for 10: a first-party interactive API explorer or 'try it' console, runnable code examples in the reference, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the reference experience.
